snapshots.title: Choose the axes before calculating
snapshots.alt: The classroom model starts at positive 120 million kilometers on the x axis with Earth at the origin. Toward-Earth motion has negative x velocity. Maz and Nadia explain that changing axes changes signs, not the motion.
snapshots.body: Day 5 uses the novel’s fixed axes: +x points toward the starting location; +y is sideways.
snapshots.question: Why is toward-Earth velocity negative on these axes?
snapshots.work: Part 1 · Check the start, change and axes

snapshots.title: A negative coordinate is not a collision
snapshots.alt: Eli asks whether negative x means a collision. Maz points to the positive y coordinate. The straight model path starts at 120 million kilometers on x and ends at negative 11.36 million x and positive 35.20 million y, passing above Earth.
snapshots.body: Use both coordinates to describe the endpoint. The six-month separation is about 37 million km.
snapshots.question: Why is this endpoint distance different from closest approach?

snapshots.title: The window is part of the answer
snapshots.alt: Eli and Maz discuss measurement limits. A rectangle around the predicted endpoint extends 3.25 million kilometers from the center in each coordinate. It represents bounds on x and y, not an impact probability.
snapshots.question: What is the full width? What does this window leave out?
snapshots.work: Part 3 · Defend the window and its limits

snapshots.title: Test what the model leaves out
snapshots.alt: Mr. Antocci says the window covers only the measurement limits included. Nadia asks about the Sun’s gravity. Maz circles constant velocity because gravity changes velocity and the straight-line model leaves it out.
snapshots.body: Measurement bounds do not automatically include missing physics.
snapshots.question: What observation would test constant velocity, and what model change would address gravity?
snapshots.work: Part 3 · Defend the window and its limits

notes: Original executable logic, timers and reveal controls unchanged. Teacher-only slides/notes removed. Four snapshots use viewport crops of existing immutable artwork with text companions. Made the supplied position and velocity bounds explicitly componentwise with exact elapsed time.
